title: Thuggy
description:
Mod includes:
Ridable Thuggy-  It runs away but isnt hostile, unless you hit it. You can ride it aswell!
Thugblock- It glows and works as a tramboline. It makes you jump extremely high.
Thug Repellant-  Weapon against Thuggy. It has 13 ATK dmg.
body:
Hello! Im Lara and this is my first ever test mod. With this mod im trying to learn how the process of making one works. This mod is trash honestly but i hope to make a real one in the future.

Mod is for Forge 1.20.1

Mod includes:

Ridable Thuggy- Its like a cockroach, it runs away but isnt hostile, unless you hit it. You can ride it aswell!

Thugblock- A block that resembles Thuggy, It glows and works as a tramboline. But be careful, it makes you jump extremely high.

Thug Repellant- Basically a weapon against Thuggy. It deals 13 attack dmg.

Thats about it :)
